Name: Ridgeside Village - Daia wedding dress change
Author: Cedarwood7916
Description:
I spliced together sprites made by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81588608]Elaho[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url] from their mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10729]Penny Irish Wedding Dress[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], respectively.

I want to clarify that literally all I did was edit a few sprites together using [url=https://www.piskelapp.com/]Piskelapp[/url]. Credit for the face of the edited sprites and the rest of the unchanged sprites in the sprite sheet goes entirely to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]! Full credit for the dress part of the edited sprites goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81588608]Elaho[/url]! PLEASE go support these creators, all of their stuff is genuinely amazing! 

INSTALLATION WILL BE A LITTLE WIERD.
This will download as a zip file containing a file called 'README' and an image called 'Daia'. Select and copy the image file. Next , in your files, go to Mods > Ridgeside Village > [CP] Ridgeside Village > Assets > Characters and paste into there. Replace the file that's already there called 'Daia'. The file called 'README' is just a text file summarizing the mod and installation. DO NOT EXTRACT THIS AND PUT IT INTO YOUR MODS LIST. IT WILL NOT WORK IF YOU INSTALL IT LIKE THAT.

honestly I have no clue if that will be different for Mac or Linux, since I only use Windows﻿﻿. There isn't an exclusive android version, but you might be able to make it work depending on how android modding works. Sorry about my lack of knowledge there!

If there are errors... sorry, I guess. I'm no coder, I'm just someone who's alright at pixel art and wanted to make this. If there are errors here on Nexus, or that you've noticed and know how to fix, feel free to contact me. You'll be fully credited if you do anything remotely useful or needed.

Downloads.Description: the only file ya need. Make sure you go back to the description for Installation instructions! It is NOT the same as other mods!
